lyrics:
[Intro: dreamy guitar chords, soft synth, wordless hum]
Ooh, ooh

[Verse 1: light high tenor, melodic, half mumbled]
You get by on a glass of water and a window
I forget you for a week, you only lean in closer
Every time I'm leaving, every time I'm gone
You put out a new leaf like nothing's wrong

[Chorus: both voices, soft beat, wide and warm]
You're a houseplant
Growing toward me
I don't deserve the way you stay
You're a houseplant
Still in the morning
I left you in the dark
And you grew anyway

[Verse 2: warbling baritone, slower phrasing]
I'm bad at this, I lose the things I hold
Too much or not enough is all I know
But you keep on, you keep on
Green in a grey apartment
Green in a grey apartment

[Chorus: both voices, soft beat, wide and warm]
You're a houseplant
Growing toward me
I don't deserve the way you stay
You're a houseplant
Still in the morning
I left you in the dark
And you grew anyway

[Bridge: beat drops, high voice alone with guitar]
I'll move you to the window
I'll learn your name
I'll be here in the morning
I'll try to be the rain

[Final Chorus: both voices, fuller, harmony on top]
You're a houseplant
Growing toward me
I don't deserve the way you stay
You're a houseplant
Still in the morning
I left you in the dark
And you grew anyway

[Outro: hum, guitar chord left ringing]
Ooh, you grew anyway
